title: Super grant escrow: Agents that pay each other
intent: This wallet holds Example Foundation's budget for super grant e8d40ff66722a7797328c7d55fb22b0eebf11c678d13c9d252dcfa8eb56c9444: We want working tools that let one AI agent pay another for a service on Solana, with a receipt both sides can check. It pays each admitted grantee its base grant, pays outcome tranches only after a jury cleared the grantee's response and found the outcome met, and returns the unearned rest to the foundation after the program ends.
judgment: Does this transaction pay exactly the entitlements named in the case, each earned under the program's terms, log and verified rulings?
